answer_1.quote: This study proposes a multi-stage pipeline that activates language models to leverage both phonetic and semantic information... Our evaluation shows SFT with subtask datasets enhances the model's ability to use phonological information for basic phonetic tasks.
datasets: Chinese Internet Homophone and Paronym Restoration (CIHP)
answer_1.outputs: Restored original words from homophones/paronyms in Chinese sentences

answer_4.quote: From this content, three native Chinese annotators collaboratively identified 352 high-frequency, representative pairs of target and original words. Each pair was included... only after reaching a consensus among all three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators determined valid homophones/paronyms by checking if phonological restoration maintains contextual semantic consistency ('1' valid if restorable, '0' invalid if semantic conflict)
